_comment: WHY THIS FILE WAS EMPTY, AND WHY IT IS NOT ANY MORE
14,641 programmatic location pages were built and every one was held at
noindex by an allow-list that was never populated. The gate, the scorer and
the threshold were all written; the list was left empty, so nothing ever
opened - including the 1,049 pages that pass the site's own quality bar.
Search Console for the three months to 2026-08-19 says what that cost:
22 of the site's 26 clicks and 329 of its 565 impressions come from location
pages, and all of them are noindex. Google is still ranking them - position
1.0 at Wiedlisbach, 1.3 at Adliswil Stadtkern, 2.2 at Huendli-Zopf, 7.0 at
Bad Abbach - because it indexed them before the gate closed. It will drop
them as it recrawls. The site was about to lose 85% of its clicks to a list
nobody filled in.
TWO KINDS OF EVIDENCE, KEPT APART ON PURPOSE
approved_urls holds pages approved on SEARCH EVIDENCE: they already rank in
the top fifteen for a real query. They are listed here rather than in entries
because most of them do not pass the quality score, and that disagreement is
the point. The scorer measures how much of the prose is unique to the page.
Google is measuring whether the page answers 'tiny house bad abbach'. Only 23
of the 157 satisfy both. A page sitting at position 1 is demonstrably useful
to the person who searched, whatever its originality score says, and the
honest response is to record which test it passed rather than to bend either
test until they agree.
entries holds pages approved on the QUALITY SCORE, at or above
minimum_quality_score. build-seo-governance-v7.mjs re-checks that number, so
an entry cannot be promoted by editing status alone.
WHAT IS STILL CLOSED
13,458 pages. That is deliberate. Opening all 14,641 would put a corpus with a
mean originality of 63 into the index at once, which is the risk the gate was
built for in the first place. This opens 1,183 - the ones with evidence - and
leaves the rest for the next measurement.
TO REVIEW THIS LATER
node tools/score-location-pages.mjs      the quality side
node tools/score-indexed-originality.mjs the indexed set as a whole
data/gsc/                                the search side, once exports are in
A page that stops ranking is not automatically removed. Removing it is a
decision with the same evidence in front of you, not a side effect.
search_evidence_rule: position <= 15 in the Search Console export, on a page that exists (URLs Google still holds under a corrected Danish slug are resolved through _redirects first)
